name: Mishiba Ryousuke
source: Mishiba Ryousuke is an ill young guy suffering from severe psychological problems who escaped from his house confinement in search for freedom. On the night of his escape, he met a [url=https://vndb.org/c12874]strange young woman[/url] at one of the cliffs of a neighbouring Tokiwa village. Very soon, they developed a certain relationship and neither of them will be happy to part away from each other.
